description: Power Players' rankings of officials and candidates by citizen rating: order 'desc' lists the most loved, order 'asc' the most hated. window selects lifetime or the last 7 or 30 days; state is a two-letter code like 'CA'. Page through results with the returned nextCursor. Ordering is the site's citizen-rating ranking; boosts and paid features never change it. branch narrows to federal, state or local offices; office is one office within that branch (for example 'senate' or 'governor'; an unknown office for the branch is refused); kind switches between officials (default) and candidates.
name: get_leaderboard
title: Get leaderboard
